# u8g2 integration

- Upstream: https://github.com/olikraus/u8g2
- Version: `2.36.19`
- Commit: `46b7f48bcb7bde787d214352873fba9baeccfb71`
- License: see `LICENSE`

Only the C graphics core, the SSD1306 128x32 display driver, and the APIs used
by this firmware are vendored. Arduino/C++ adapters, unrelated display drivers,
menus, logs, and the complete 40 MB generated font catalog are intentionally
excluded.

`csrc/u8g2_fonts_selected.c` contains only the two public-domain ASCII fonts
used by the UI. `csrc/u8g2_font_ec_ui_12.c` is a 243-byte u8g2 font generated
from the upstream Efont Biwidth `tools/font/bdf/b12.bdf`; it contains only the
Unicode glyphs `电量池正常低负载`.

The subset is reproducible with the 2.36.19 `bdfconv` tool:

```text
bdfconv -f 1 -b 0 -m '$7535,$91cf,$6c60,$6b63,$5e38,$4f4e,$8d1f,$8f7d' -n u8g2_font_ec_ui_12 -o u8g2_font_ec_ui_12.c b12.bdf
```

`csrc/u8g2_font_ec_values_9x15.c` is a 269-byte subset of the upstream
public-domain `9x15.bdf`, used by the two-line value page. It is generated by:

```text
bdfconv -f 1 -b 0 -m '32,45-57,65,86-87,115' -n u8g2_font_ec_values_9x15 -o u8g2_font_ec_values_9x15.c 9x15.bdf
```
